cases.sentence: ___, отец Шихема, пришел переговорить с Иаковом.
cases.translation: Hamor, the father of Shechem, came to talk with Jacob.
cases.explain: Хамор is the subject of the verb пришёл ('came'), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Молодой человек без ___ исполнил то, что они сказали.
cases.translation: The young man did what they had said without delay.
cases.explain: The preposition без ('without') always takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Сердце его прилепилось к ___, дочери Иакова, он полюбил ее.
cases.translation: His heart was drawn to Dinah, Jacob's daughter, and he loved her.
cases.explain: The preposition к ('to/toward') requires the dative case.

cases.sentence: Но если вы не согласитесь сделать обрезание, мы заберем ___ и уйдем.
cases.translation: But if you do not agree to be circumcised, we will take our sister and go.
cases.explain: Сестру is the direct object of the transitive verb заберём ('we will take'), which requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Они убили ___ Хамора и его сына Шехема, забрали Дину из Шехемова дома и ушли.
cases.translation: They killed Hamor and his son Shechem with the sword, took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and left.
cases.explain: Мечом is the instrumental of means ('with/by the sword'), used without a preposition to show the instrument of the action.

cases.sentence: Они были полны горя и ярости, потому что Шихем сделал постыдное дело в ___, когда лег с дочерью Иакова, а такое недопустимо.
cases.translation: They were full of grief and fury, because Shechem had done a disgraceful thing in Israel by lying with Jacob's daughter, which ought not to be done.
cases.explain: The preposition в ('in'), indicating location, requires the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Дина, дочь Лии от Иакова, пошла навестить местных женщин.
reading.question: What did Dinah go out to do?
options: To see the women of the land
To visit her brothers in the field
To fetch water from a well
reading.correct: To see the women of the land
reading.explain: The text says Dinah went out to visit/see the local women of the land.

reading.ru: Когда Шехем, сын Хевея, Хамора, правителя той области, увидел ее, то схватил, лег с ней и обесчестил ее.
reading.question: What did Shechem do to Dinah when he saw her?
options: He arranged a formal marriage first
He seized her, lay with her, and violated her
He gave her gifts and left
He sent her back to Jacob
reading.correct: He seized her, lay with her, and violated her
reading.explain: The text states that Shechem seized Dinah, lay with her, and dishonored (violated) her.

reading.ru: Хамор, отец Шихема, пришел переговорить с Иаковом.
reading.question: Why did Hamor go to Jacob?
options: To negotiate/talk with him about the matter
reading.correct: To negotiate/talk with him about the matter
reading.explain: The text says Hamor came to talk with (negotiate with) Jacob.

reading.ru: Тогда сыновья Иакова ответили Шехему и его отцу Хамору лживо, потому что он обесчестил их сестру Дину.
reading.question: How did Jacob's sons answer Shechem and Hamor?
options: Deceitfully, because Shechem had defiled their sister Dinah
They refused to speak at all
reading.correct: Deceitfully, because Shechem had defiled their sister Dinah
reading.explain: The text says Jacob's sons answered deceitfully because Shechem had defiled their sister Dinah.

reading.ru: Мы дадим согласие лишь при одном условии, если вы станете как мы и сделаете всем вашим мужчинам обрезание.
reading.question: Under what one condition would Jacob's sons agree to the marriage?
options: That Shechem pay a huge dowry
That every man of the city be circumcised
That the city worship their God
reading.correct: That every man of the city be circumcised
reading.explain: The sons of Jacob said they would only consent if all the men became circumcised like them.

reading.ru: Все, кто собирались у городских ворот, согласились с Хамором и его сыном Шехемом, и все мужчины в городе были обрезаны.
reading.question: What happened after the men at the city gate agreed with Hamor and Shechem?
options: All the men of the city were circumcised
The city was destroyed at once
They drove Hamor out of the city
reading.correct: All the men of the city were circumcised
reading.explain: The text says the men agreed with Hamor and Shechem, and every man in the city was circumcised.

reading.ru: Три дня спустя, когда они еще страдали от боли, двое сыновей Иакова, Симеон и Левий, братья Дины, взяли мечи, неожиданно напали на город и убили всех мужчин.
reading.question: What did Simeon and Levi do on the third day?
options: They forgave the men of the city
They took their swords, attacked the city, and killed all the men
reading.correct: They took their swords, attacked the city, and killed all the men
reading.explain: The text says that while the men were still in pain, Simeon and Levi took their swords, attacked the city, and killed all the males.

reading.ru: Тогда Иаков сказал Симеону и Левию, вы навлекли на меня беду, сделали меня ненавистным для жителей этой земли, хананеев и ферезеев.
reading.question: What was Jacob's reaction to what Simeon and Levi had done?
options: He praised them for defending their sister's honor
He said they had brought trouble on him and made him odious to the land's inhabitants
reading.correct: He said they had brought trouble on him and made him odious to the land's inhabitants
reading.explain: Jacob told Simeon and Levi that they had brought trouble on him, making him odious to the Canaanites and Perizzites who lived in the land.
